«Генерация» — создание видео (3 режима:: “Generation” — create videos (3 modes: Text / Frames / References), “Extend” — continue a finished clip, “Refine” — improve video quality, “ControlNet” — precise motion transfer from a reference video (3D mannequins), “Tile Upscale” and “DLSS” — two ways to raise sharpness, “FPS” — make motion smoother, “Face Refine” — redraw small faces, “Gallery” — all finished videos, “Montage” — build a clip from several videos, “Learning” — this tour. The Assistant (a chat helper for prompts) is the right-hand panel on the “Generation” and “Extend” tabs. The sidebar can be collapsed.
«Глубина (Depth)» — универсальный вариан: “Depth” — the universal choice: it transfers the volumes of the scene and the camera motion (it needs the small Depth Anything model, downloaded in the same place). “Canny” — follows object edges, good for clean line work. “Control strength” at 1.0 means strict following; lower is freer. “Release control after” (say 0.6) — the model finishes the detail more freely toward the end of generation, which helps when the image comes out “flat”. The pipeline steps here are the same as on the “Generation” tab: the split point and “Total steps (pass 1)” default to 6 out of 6.
«Драфт» — быстрый черновик, чтобы провер: “Draft” — a quick draft to test an idea. “Full” — the final version, which takes longer to compute.
«Зерно» случайности: -1 = каждый раз нов: The “grain” of randomness: -1 = a new one every time. Liked the result? Take the seed from the metadata and repeat with it.
«Перенос моделей из старой версии» — выб: “Transfer models from an older version” — pick the folder of the old build and the program finds ALL models folders itself (the root one + ComfyUI/models) and moves their contents. Data-loss protection: chat-file checks, unlinkSync errors handled. “Main model” — the base one (FastH3 VSA DataFree 4-step INT8). “Custom model folders” — add your own folders with models. “Custom model (GGUF)” — folder picking with a “Choose folder” button. Downloading models (and copying LoRAs) is not interrupted by closing the settings window. Bonsai light (the small version) is optional — no banner required.
«Полное» (два прохода) или «Драфт» (один: “Full” (two passes) or “Draft” (one), steps, seed. Safe to skip.
«Проход (шаги)»: 2 — самый быстрый, 3 —: “Pass (steps)”: 2 — the fastest, 3 — the default (the same reference sigma profile as pass 2 in generation), 4–7 — more detail but slower (the same sigma ladders as generation’s Pass 2; 7 is the maximum). “Refine influence” (30–95%) — how strongly the network redraws the frame: higher gives more new detail, lower stays closer to the original; the default is 60%. Below the slider you can see the actual sigma ladder the sampler will get, and the “Pass 2” button sets the exact reference ladder of generation’s second pass in one click (3 steps from σ 0.9035). The prompt and references are taken from the original’s saved metadata (extended videos keep every segment’s prompt). The Match / Max reference mode is configured separately: Match is faster, Max holds faces more faithfully (Max by default).
«Сделай красиво как в фильме…» — называй: “Make it beautiful like in a movie…” — name concrete things: light, angle, camera movement, sound.
«Сначала покажи улицу, потом режь на кру: “First show the street, then cut to a close-up” — the model doesn’t do editing or cuts: it’s one continuous take.
«Текст» — просто описать сцену. «Кадры»: “Text” — just describe the scene. “Frames” — set the first and last frame. “References” — show images or video examples.
«Minimax H3 (генерация)» — движок видео:: “Minimax H3 (generation)” — the video engine: the diffusion model (FastH3 VSA DataFree 4-step INT8, ~22.9 GB), the text encoder (~15.7 GB), VAE, upscaler, Turbo LoRA (~1.8 GB) and more — ~44.5 GB required in total; Turbo LoRA is on by default in every mode (except “Frames” with audio), and “Download all” pulls it along with the base models. “LLM assistant” — the chat model: Qwen3.5 9B by default (~5.7 GB, vision); alternatives are Gemma 4 12B (Q3/Q4/Q5) or Bonsai 2 27B (ternary, ~7.2 GB, vision). Optional: FPS models (RIFE + FILM VFI). Choosing ONE LLM model is enough.
×2 — удвоение FPS (24→48), ×3 — утроение: ×2 doubles the FPS (24→48), ×3 triples it (24→72), ×4 quadruples it (24→96). The higher the multiplier, the longer the processing and the more VRAM it needs.

В режиме «Референсы» генерация запускает: In the “References” mode, generation also starts from a prompt alone. References are about precision: up to 15 files — 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio. Images say who/what, videos say how it moves, audio gives voice and sound. A screenshot can just be pasted with Ctrl+V. In the “Text” mode images and video refs are not used — audio only; in the “Frames” mode images are set by the “First frame” / “Last frame” fields. Clicking the preview of any reference opens it full screen — that way you can see details you can’t make out in a tiny square. It works the same on every tab: “Generation”, “Extend”, “Refine”, “ControlNet”, “FPS”, “Upscale”.
В списке — все .safetensors-файлы из пап: The list contains every .safetensors file from the program’s LoRA folder: both those downloaded in Settings → Models and those added with the “Add” button. The built-in turbo LoRA (4-step) is in the list too and is on by default — it speeds up generation. One exception: in “Frames” mode with added audio, the turbo LoRA is automatically skipped, while regular LoRAs work as usual. Every entry has an on/off toggle and a strength slider from −10 to +10. User LoRAs are off by default. Your own LoRAs additionally have a trigger-words field — when the LoRA is on, they are added to the prompt automatically.

Деноизинг (сила перерисовки) 0.05–1.0, п: Denoise (redraw strength) 0.05–1.0, default 0.2 — a gentle mode: detail is added, but the source barely changes; higher means a stronger redraw, but more risk of a “melted” result. Steps — 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 or 8, default 2; more steps take longer and bring no noticeable gain. SyncTile lives in “Advanced settings” (the ▼ button) — the technology that removes flicker and visible seams at the tile joins; it is on by default and you do not need to turn it off. If your own LoRA are enabled in “Settings”, they apply here too.
Денойз — насколько сильно перерисовывает: Denoise — how strongly the face is redrawn. Values from the SDXL family do not carry over here: H3 is flow matching with shift 12, so 0.25 turns into an effective sigma of 0.800 and rewrites the whole frame. The working range is 0.25–0.40. Canvas — the size at which the face is regenerated: 512 costs about 2.25 times less memory than 768, and on 12 GB start with 512; presets go up to 1280 — values above 768 are markedly more expensive in VRAM and time (the model was trained on canvases up to 768×1344). Steps — 4 (our model is a 4-step model).

Для каждого нового куска задаются длител: For each new segment you set a duration (3–30 seconds — very short segments can show a noticeable jump at the join) and a prompt describing what should happen next. You can queue up several segments in a row. The “Pass quality” toggle: “Full” (the default) generates each segment at draft resolution and immediately redraws it up to the source resolution; “Draft” is faster but lower in quality. “Sampler steps” defaults to “auto”: the app takes the pass 1 step count from the source’s metadata (no metadata — same as the “Generation” tab); you can also set it manually (2–30), and your value is then used. A finished video in the “Gallery” can be continued without dragging — use the “Extend” button on its card.
Для лица три способа: клик по лицу в кад: There are three ways to pick a face: click a face in the source frame — the most accurate (the tracker takes the face nearest the point and follows that person through the whole clip); a rule (“Largest face”, “Closest to center”…) plus a rank number — always works, but sees only the frame geometry; or a reference photo of a specific person — face matching via insightface (the buffalo_l model downloads itself).
480p and 5 seconds is enough for your first tries. It’s faster and easier on your computer.

Долгие диалоги «съедают» память. Квантиз: Long chats “eat up” memory. KV-cache quantization (Settings → LLM: Q8 / Q5 / Q4) noticeably reduces the chat’s memory use, with a quality loss that is barely noticeable in the answers. Q4 is on by default — the most economical mode; “Off” is only worth choosing if you want maximum accuracy and have enough memory.

Источник движения: 3D-болванка (previz и: Your motion source: a 3D blockout (previz from Blender and the like), a rough animation, or any clip whose camera and object motion you want to repeat. The source’s appearance is NOT transferred — only its motion. You can drag the video in from the “Gallery” (or via the ⋮ menu → “ControlNet (motion)”), or pick it from disk. This mode runs on the same MiniMax H3 model as ordinary generation, so no separate ControlNet models are needed. You additionally need the Depth Anything V2 Small depth preprocessor (~99 MB) — it is in “Settings” → Models, under the “Preprocessors” category; it is also flagged “optional”, meaning the depth-map preprocessing will not start without it. Besides the prompt you can add reference images — a character, a location or a frame (up to 9); in the prompt you refer to them as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>…

Режим «Полное» — два прохода: сначала бы: “Full” mode is two passes: first a fast draft at low resolution (from 0.2 MP, but no larger than the final), then refinement up to target quality. “Draft” mode is a single pass in draft quality: noticeably faster; in the gallery such a video gets a red “Draft” badge, and you can bring it up to full quality with the “Refine” tab. The draft pass steps are set by TWO numbers: “Sampler steps” is the split point (how many sigmas the draft takes, slider 2–30, default 6); “Total steps (pass 1)” is the length of the whole schedule (by default the same as the split point, i.e. “6 of 6”). Under the fields there is a live summary, “Pass 1: 6 of 6 · σ 1.0 → 0.167”: it shows how far the draft goes. You can set the total manually — for example, 8: then the draft takes 6 of the 8 sigmas and goes deeper into the noise. References have a Match / Max mode: Match is faster, Max holds the resemblance more precisely.
Резерв VRAM (1–16 ГБ, по умолчанию 3) и: The VRAM reserve (1–16 GB, default 3) and Dynamic VRAM control ComfyUI’s video memory — they apply after ComfyUI restarts. The “VRAM reserve” is the main lever: ComfyUI’s model manager subtracts it from the available memory and evicts/offloads weights earlier, so things never reach 100% VRAM. The “Free VRAM headroom” (0–8 GB, default 2 GB) is an extra safety net on the native DynamicVRAM layer side (comfy-aimdo): it watches the actually free VRAM via NVML, including other apps, and won’t let it be taken for weights. Low VRAM Attention and Chunk FeedForward save memory right during generation — they apply to new generations immediately, without a restart. If generation fails with out-of-video-memory, raise the “VRAM reserve”, turn both switches on and/or lower the resolution.

LoRA — «надстройка» над основной моделью: A LoRA is an “add-on” on top of the base model: it adds a style, a character or an object.
LoRA — небольшая «надстройка» поверх осн: A LoRA is a small “add-on” on top of the base model: it can add a style, a character or an object. Strength is controlled with a slider: 0 means no effect, and the further from zero, the stronger it is; values around 1 are usually enough. The turbo LoRA is a 4-step accelerator; if you turn it off, generation runs without it (slower). Enabled LoRAs work not only in regular generation but also in Refine, Tile Upscale and “Extend” — the style is preserved at every stage.
Low VRAM Attention и Chunk FeedForward э: Low VRAM Attention and Chunk FeedForward save video memory — they live in Settings → Optimization, not in the generation form. If generation fails with an VRAM shortage, keep them on or lower the resolution.
Neural Rendering (DLSS 5) — нейросеть «п: Neural Rendering (DLSS 5) — a neural network “redraws” the frame: noise, tone and structure are adjustable and a preset is chosen — quality goes up, but speed goes down. RTX Video Super Resolution — 1×–4× speed-up (including 1.5×; HDR is disabled — H.264 doesn’t support HDR output) — faster and lighter on the GPU. The mode is chosen right on the tab, and the launch button adapts to it.
Refine — это повторная генерация (нейрос: Refine is re-generation (the network “thinks” about the frame), not simply stretching the image. It is slower but the quality is higher: detail, textures and faces are redrawn rather than enlarged. It is a great way to upgrade the “Draft” outputs from the “Generation” tab.
Refine улучшает детали и «рисует» недост: Refine improves details and “paints in” the missing sharpness. Tile Upscale gently enlarges a finished video piece by piece, in tiles.
RIFE VFI — быстрый, подходит для слабых: RIFE VFI — fast, a good fit for weak GPUs. FILM VFI — better quality but heavier. Both run locally, on your own graphics card.
RIFE VFI и FILM VFI: плавность движения: RIFE VFI and FILM VFI: smooth motion on weak GPUs.
Space — пауза, M — звук, стрелки ← → — с: Space — pause, M — sound, ← → arrows — next/previous video, Esc — exit.
Video Frame Interpolation: нейросеть «до: Video Frame Interpolation: the neural network “draws in” in-between frames between the existing ones. 24 fps → 48 fps (×2) makes the motion smoother.
